population.admission: one pooled-global cross-side/cross-timestamp book after each score's own causal recent-EV map

outer_folds.name: mapping_calibration
outer_folds.role: OOF history for mapping only; excluded from architecture selection

purge.inner: last chronological 25% of each side's outer-training timestamps; fit rows require label_end < inner_validation_start

raw_oof_alpha.rule: verify byte equality and report as already present in score4; never add the duplicate alias as an incremental feature

side_candidate_group_size.rule: verify byte equality; use only the canonical field

unavailable_candidate_context.archetype_relative_z_score: Unavailable in the canonical 2025 lineage. Fail closed and do not substitute DAE/GMM/posterior geometry. It requires a separately sealed, inference-time, fold-local archetype materialization before it can become an arm.

A0.rule: evaluate each of the four score4 streams independently; no learned meta model

A1_context.rule: freeze the March-selected A1 support arm, then compare context_none with each predeclared candidate-context field group individually under the same folds, causal map and stability objective
A1_context.raw_oof_alpha_rule: score_base_alpha and base_oof_score must be byte-identical; the already-present score_base_alpha anchor is the raw-OOF-alpha arm and duplicate insertion is forbidden
A1_context.winner_rule: select context_none or one context arm on March mapped selection folds only; pass the frozen winner to A2-A5
A1_context.archetype_rule: record unavailable_candidate_context explicitly; no proxy substitution

A2.rule: P(pre-exit meaningful MFE) then conditional P(net-positive capture) and conditional positive/adverse net magnitudes

A3.rule: P(clean favorable-first) times conditional signed payoff, with complement adverse magnitude

A4.rule: three-class favorable-first/adverse-conflict/timeout probabilities times class-conditional signed net payoff

A5.rule: March-selected winner of A1-A4 plus exactly five fold-side-train-standardized base_oof_score x 12h transition interactions clipped to [-1,1]

catboost_hpo.classifier_selection: minimum inner log loss, then Brier, then shallower geometry
catboost_hpo.multiclass_selection: minimum inner multiclass log loss, then shallower geometry
catboost_hpo.regressor_selection: minimum inner MAE, then maximum rank IC, then shallower geometry

feature_selection.scope: separate for every outer fold, side and head after inner geometry selection
feature_selection.method: CatBoost PredictionValuesChange from the winning inner-fit model only
feature_selection.rule: positive importance, cumulative 90%, minimum 8 and maximum 24; force score anchors that belong to the arm
feature_selection.refit: winning geometry and selected features refit on the full legal outer-training subset

mapping.rule: separate score-specific daily 21-day pooled isotonic anchor plus shrunk-side residual
mapping.causality: only labels resolved and scores available strictly before each daily snapshot

selection.objective: fold mean net bps - 0.5*fold std + 0.25*worst fold net bps
selection.tie_break: fewer selected features, shallower mean geometry, lexical config

mandatory_ic_ev_divergence_diagnostic.motivation: Base-target rank IC rises from 0.155 in February to 0.162 in March and 0.226 in April while direct execution-EV pooled-global top-decile net remains negative at -59.39, -91.31 and -38.45 bps. This is an unresolved conversion anomaly, not an architectural justification.
waterfall: exact 12h favorable opportunity and MFE rank IC
deployed-exit gross rank IC and top-k gross bps
exact deployed-policy net rank IC and top-k net bps
tail_diagnostics: pooled-global top 1/5/10/20% economics and tail-local rank IC
opportunity precision, recall and conditional payoff magnitude
fixed numeric cutoff versus fixed quantile migration
score range, dispersion, saturation and cutoff-tie fraction
side, asset, regime, stop and timeout composition
within-cell gross, cost and net response
mandatory_ic_ev_divergence_diagnostic.known_coverage_limit: The canonical February lineage lacks strict residual/direct reliability layers. February-to-March is therefore base-conversion evidence only; it must not be presented as a direct-head month comparison.
mandatory_ic_ev_divergence_diagnostic.interpretation_rule: Higher aggregate rank IC is not model progress when the globally selected cost-aware tail remains negative.
mandatory_ic_ev_divergence_diagnostic.closure_rule: Keep the item open until the month-to-month IC/EV deltas are quantitatively reconciled and a frozen causally mapped challenger passes aggregate, latest-period, both-side, tie-safety and mapped-control economics gates.

global_book_attribution.selection: compute the pooled-global random-tie-expected book once for each score/fraction/window; attach fractional cutoff-tie weights, then slice that fixed book without reranking or quotas

dimensions.exit: execution_exit_class; realized attribution only and never a feature

metrics: expected selected rows and selected share
conditional positive and adverse payoff magnitude
global_book_attribution.prohibition: never rank or select top-k within side, asset, regime or exit slices

promotion_gates: March aggregate, latest and worst-fold mapped top10 > 0
March and April cutoff tie fraction <= 5%
April reused diagnostic mapped top10 and latest week > 0
both long and short contributions > 0 without quotas
better than identically mapped base and residual controls
new untouched forward evidence remains required
portfolio_replay: forbidden until every promotion gate passes on untouched forward evidence
